name: Ferbin Richard
headline: Autonomy that has to survive contact with the real world.

sims.k: Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Gazebo, ArduPilot SITL

rov.k: ROV taken from bench to open water

bridge.ctx: Hackachusetts 2026 · team of 3 · robots, simulation and autopilot loop mine
bridge.title: A drone above the water and an ROV below it, inspecting a real Boston bridge
bridge.summary: Real ArduCopter and ArduSub firmware fly a drone and an ROV through an Isaac Sim rebuild of the Charles River Dam crossing. Every waterline defect the drone flags, the ROV dives to inspect.

archelon.image_alt: Archelon ROV on the bench, in the pool from above, and fitted with hull-cleaning brushes
archelon.ctx: Archenaux Robotics · Jun to Sep 2026 · Boston
archelon.title: Archelon: an eight-thruster inspection ROV, from bench bring-up to open water
archelon.summary: I led the co-op engineering team, owned the sensor stack, the vehicle runtime and the detector, and took the vehicle from the bench into lakes in New Hampshire.
metrics: of sensors brought up and owned
detector mAP@50, trained on zero real images

usv.ctx: Autonomous harbour inspection · concept for a USV startup
usv.title: A waterjet boat that patrols a harbour, spots what changed, and docks itself
usv.summary: ArduRover SITL drives a 4.2 m twin-waterjet USV on my own Fossen hydrodynamics and JONSWAP sea, lock-stepped over ArduPilot's JSON backend and path-traced in Isaac Sim.

hyperion.ctx: Hyperion · Dell x NVIDIA GB10 · Grok Bot · Wajo x Anthropic
hyperion.title: A 20-robot warehouse where AI agents find the fault and get a technician on the phone
hyperion.summary: Twenty Nova Carters in Isaac Sim. Agents detect faults, re-plan the fleet with Hungarian assignment and, through Fo, place real calls to an on-call technician. Code enforces, the model explains.
metrics: real phone calls in live runs

intake.ctx: Intake-cleaning robot · startup study and pitch film
intake.title: An underwater robot that clears mussels from power-plant intakes, rendered physically
intake.summary: Path-traced in Isaac Sim with MDL materials and procedural mussel instancers; the water is my own compositor working from depth.
metrics: render time per frame, BVH fix

awards: Bridge inspection with a drone and an ROV on real ArduPilot firmware
Won Track 2, The Open Accelerator healthcare hackathon
Hosted by Red Hat with IBM Ventures and the Mass AI Hub

index.eyebrow: Robotics Software Engineer · Boston, MA · M.S. Robotics, Northeastern, April 2027
index.sub: I build simulation rigs that run real autopilot firmware, then take the same code into the water. Perception, estimation and control across humanoid, quadruped, manipulator, ground, aerial and underwater robots.

sim.eyebrow: Robotics Simulation Engineer · Boston, MA · M.S. Robotics, Northeastern, April 2027
sim.sub: I build simulation rigs that run real autopilot firmware: ArduPilot SITL in the loop with Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo and Gazebo, with every result measured and replayable, and I check them against a real robot in real water.

field.eyebrow: Robotics Field & Deployment Engineer · Boston, MA · M.S. Robotics, Northeastern, April 2027
field.sub: I take robots from bench bring-up to open water and debug them where they fail: sensors, firmware, tethers, networks and the operator's console. Then I build the simulation that stops it happening twice.
